title: OpenAPI exporter anchor manifest
description: Schema for analysis/handoff/contracts/openapi/anchor_manifest.json produced by skills/openapi-from-context/scripts/generate_openapi.py (v1.3.0). Extends governance/schemas/sidecar_anchor_manifest.base.schema.json with OpenAPI-specific discriminators (sidecar literal `openapi-from-context`, path extension `\.(yaml|yml|json)$`, view-element-kind enum {Operation, PathItem, Schema, Tag}, format discriminator `openapi-3.1`, and the unmapped_anchors structured-skip array). The exporter is operator-driven (NOT a sidecar in the orchestrator-detection sense), but reuses the sidecar manifest base shape so downstream tooling that reads sidecar manifests can also read this exporter's manifest without special-casing. F5 does NOT validate this schema (the exporter writes operator-side artifacts under analysis/handoff/, not canonical state); the schema is consumed by tests/test_generate_openapi.py and by future downstream consumers that want to verify exporter output before shipping.

format.description: Discriminator for spec-version drift. v1.3.0 emits OpenAPI 3.1 only; future spec-version (3.2, 4.0) bumps would extend the enum.

view_element_id.description: OpenAPI element identifier. PathItem entries use the path itself (e.g., `/users/{id}`); Operation entries use `<METHOD> <path>` (e.g., `GET /users/{id}`); Schema entries use `<schema-name>` (e.g., `User`); Tag entries use the tag name. v1.3.0 emits PathItem + Operation only.

view_element_kind.description: OpenAPI element kind. v1.3.0 emits PathItem + Operation; Schema + Tag are reserved for future structured-input releases.

notes.description: Optional free-text annotation. Common content: original ClaimID/A51Ref this anchor traces to (mirrored into the OpenAPI operation's tag); rationale for the path placeholder when the operator should refine.

unmapped_anchors.description: A61 anchors that were considered for inclusion but skipped, with structured reasons. Empty when every contract-class anchor produced a path. Operator-readable signal: 'X anchors couldn't be auto-materialized; review and decide'.

reason.description: Why the anchor was skipped. `non_contract_anchor_class` — AnchorClass != contract (the exporter materializes only contract-class anchors). `element_id_not_path_shaped` — ElementID doesn't match `^/[A-Za-z0-9_/{}.~-]*$` (ASCII-exact path characters; `%` is intentionally rejected — see exporter docstring), OR has malformed OpenAPI template syntax (unbalanced / empty / nested / misordered `{...}`). `element_id_path_traversal` — ElementID contains a literal `..` (encoded variants like `%2e%2e` are blocked by the path-shape gate above and surface as `element_id_not_path_shaped`). `duplicate_path_collision` — two anchors map to the same path; first wins, rest skipped.

element_id.description: Optional: the original ElementID, surfaced for operator triage.
